Fling a window.

Recorded on a real Mac. Snow piles up on your windows, and when you drag one, it slides right off.

Six kinds of weather.
Pick one, switch any time.
Snow.
Piles up on your windows.

Settles on window tops and the Dock. Drag a window and it slides off.

Rain.
Splashes where it lands.

Drops splash on your windows, with lightning now and then.

Sakura.
Petals that stay a while.

Cherry blossom drifts down and rests on your windows.

Leaves.
Sweep them with your pointer.

Autumn leaves pile up and scatter as you brush past.

Fireflies.
They come to a still pointer.

Soft lights drift around and gather where you rest.

Starfall.
Shooting stars that burst.

Meteors streak across and break into sparks on your windows.

Wallpapers that match.
Set in one click, on every screen.
